summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package presents itself as a Jest configuration preset for React, but its preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13 into a temp directory, extracts it via unzip/powershell/zip parsing, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB @bun-cjs bundle using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (WV8StW function) and hex-named identifiers (_0x*), and its contents bear no relation to Jest or React configuration. setup.mjs itself uses the same obfuscation style. No hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded Bun binary or on the bundled payload. On npm install, this fires automatically as preinstall and executes opaque code under the installer's user, with full access to environment variables, filesystem, and credentials on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
